ACTION 22 OF 32 · PHASE 06

Run a real SEO and mobile launch audit

Make pages usable, discoverable and accurate.

WHEN TO DO THISBefore publishing, then after each significant site update.ESTIMATED WORK TIME1–3 hours
↗
Your one job

Make pages usable, discoverable and accurate.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Test on mobile widths and desktop: legible text, visible CTAs, usable menus and correct contrast.

  2. 02

    Check every link, form, booking button, image, alt text and page title.

  3. 03

    Confirm readable HTML content, canonical URLs, robots settings, sitemap, descriptive URLs and Search Console ownership.

  4. 04

    Verify genuine service-area content, internal links, redirects, 404 page and loading performance.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Audit this actual website [URL] as a customer and search engine. Check mobile UX, navigation, forms, CTA clarity, image loading, performance, accessibility, title/meta, canonical, indexability, sitemap, internal links, 404s and relevant structured data. Distinguish directly tested issues from recommendations. Rank fixes by conversion impact and implementation effort; do not say a page was tested unless you accessed it.
03

Finish with this

Launch audit with screenshots, broken-link list and repaired issues.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Real forms tested end-to-end
  • No blocking mobile usability errors
  • Correct index/robots/sitemap confirmed on public deployment
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Claiming SEO is complete because a sitemap file exists.
